title: Leo dating: 2016 vs 2026
old_caption:
Leo in 2016 brought a selfie stick to dinner.
Leo in 2026 points the camera at the date laughing. Spotlight, shared.

title: Libra dating: 2016 vs 2026
old_caption:
Ever sent twelve outfit photos to the group chat before a date?
Now Libra lets the date pick, in four seconds. One vote, the right one.

title: Date outfit: 2016 vs 2026
old_caption:
Remember flower crown filters and bangs over one eye?
Taurus in 2026 shows up in a big sweater and sneakers. Comfy is the look.

title: Pisces dating: 2016 vs 2026
old_caption:
Pisces in 2016 cried at a robot movie and blamed allergies.
In 2026 Pisces brings tissues for two, and Capricorn cries first.

title: Sagittarius dating: 2016 vs 2026
old_caption:
Were your old profile pics all mountains and no you?
Sagittarius still plans the trip, but now asks where you want to go. Adventure for two.

title: Scorpio dating: 2016 vs 2026
old_caption:
Ever posted a cryptic quote at 2 AM about someone you liked?
Scorpio's still mysterious, just readable now. Say it out loud.

title: Asking someone's sign: 2016 vs 2026
old_caption:
Still opening with a wink and asking what their sign is?
In 2026 Gemini asks about the moon sign and what feels like home. Deeper answer.

title: Taurus dating: 2016 vs 2026
old_caption:
Same booth, same order, every single date?
Routine can be romantic when you make it for two. Learn their order too.

title: Texting your crush: 2016 vs 2026
old_caption:
Ever sent just hey and waited all night?
Say the actual thing. Clear beats cool every time.

title: Virgo dating: 2016 vs 2026
old_caption:
Virgo in 2016 handed their date a four-page itinerary.
Virgo in 2026 schedules one open hour for chaos. Same Virgo, looser grip.
